title: Gossypium hirsutum gene of unknown function, Gohir.A02G039501.1, encodes a potential DNA-binding ALOG protein involved in gene regulation.
authors: Zirkel, Jonathan; Hulse-Kemp, Amanda M; Storm, Amanda R
one_liner_zh: 该文通过序列与AlphaFold2结构预测，提出棉花未知蛋白为潜在DNA结合ALOG蛋白，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但缺乏结合位点预测或动态机制研究，方法以结构预测为主，与TF-DNA课题部分相关。
abstract: A protein of unknown function encoded by gene Gohir.A02G039501.1 in Gossypium hirsutum , was studied using sequence and structure bioinformatic tools leading to its proposed function as a nuclear, DNA-binding ALOG protein involved in gene regulation during organ boundary specification and maintenance. The encoded protein contains a predicted nuclear localization sequence, an ALOG domain with conserved residues in the modeled DNA-binding regions and nearly identical sequence identity to Arabidopsis homologs involved in development of organ boundaries at the shoot apical meristem. The protein was modeled by AlphaFold2 to have a four-helix bundle that is structurally analogous to DNA-binding domains of XerC/D-like recombinases.
abstract_zh: 由基因Gohir.A02G039501.1编码的陆地棉（Gossypium hirsutum）中一个功能未知的蛋白质，通过序列和结构生物信息学工具进行了研究，其推测功能为一种核内、DNA结合的ALOG蛋白，参与器官边界特化和维持过程中的基因调控。该编码蛋白含有一个预测的核定位序列，一个在建模的DNA结合区域中具有保守残基的ALOG结构域，并且与拟南芥中参与茎尖分生组织器官边界发育的同源物具有近乎相同的序列一致性。该蛋白通过AlphaFold2建模为具有四螺旋束结构，该结构在结构上与XerC/D样重组酶的DNA结合域类似。
